title: Mystery airship phenomenon

tellings.quote: And then suddenly at the same time you have the mystery airship phenomenon.

plain: At one point in history, people in the United States and Europe began reporting strange airships in the sky, at a time when no such craft should have existed. A researcher named Tim Alberino mentions this "mystery airship phenomenon" on Michels's show, crediting the UFO historian Richard Dolan. He brings it up as something that appeared "suddenly at the same time" as other odd events he is describing, as if they were linked.
